Introducing Rowbase: turn a spreadsheet into an API in seconds

Rowbase went public on March 4, 2026. You upload a spreadsheet or data file and get a working REST API. You don't need a server, backend code, or any setup.

We built it because many teams keep useful data in files their apps can't reach. With Rowbase, you upload the file and the queryable endpoint is live right away. It accepts five file formats.

Before launch, 212 beta users tried Rowbase on internal dashboards, side projects, and prototypes for customers. Their feedback made setup faster, cleaned up the endpoints, and removed a lot of surprises.

The free tier gives you 1,000 requests a day. That covers prototyping, personal projects, or a small production workload. If you need more, there are paid plans.

Thanks to every beta tester who helped us get here. We're looking forward to seeing what people build with it.

To get started, upload your first file.
